opening_brief.intro: 本次更新可先看「Nearby Supernova Science in the Era of High Cadence, Deep Time Domain Surveys」等论文；以下导读仅概括已核对的来源内容。

opening_brief.worth_knowing_summary: 其他值得知道的工作：基准模型预测 SLSN 体积率在 z≈3.3 达峰，约为 1,300 Gpc⁻³ yr⁻¹；高红移率比仅按宇宙恒星形成率密度缩放的估计至少高约十倍。；非零中微子质量通常解除对称轴上的模式简并；在三维波矢空间中，简并一般仍可能沿一维线存在。；其余见下方卡片。

highlights.title: Nearby Supernova Science in the Era of High Cadence, Deep Time Domain Surveys
highlights.reason: 与研究组的激波破越、周星介质相互作用、爆前失质量、早期光电离及平台期几何研究直接相关。其主要效用是将早期超新星诊断与巡天深度、采样频率、快速光谱和基础设施要求联系起来，为样本建设与观测方案提供规划依据；不是新的爆炸机制实测验证。

highlights.title: HESS J1507-622: A Plausible Young Galactic Kilonova Remnant
highlights.reason: 与致密天体高能观测、遗迹激波粒子加速及中微子方向有实质联系。论文提出将一个缺少可信低能对应体的银河系扩展伽马射线源解释为年轻千新星遗迹，并给出年龄、距离及多波段检验途径。研究效用在于提供可检验的候选源模型和参数约束，而非已经确认其千新星起源。

highlights.title: VLBI Astrometric Procedure and Performance with CHIME/FRB Outriggers
highlights.reason: 与FRB宿主关联、局部环境及磁离子介质研究直接相关：本文提供一次性FRB精密定位的实现方法、校准策略和误差检验，是构建可解析宿主内部环境样本的方法基础。研究效用在于定位流程与可信区间的可靠性，而非直接给出FRB起源或环境的物理结论。

highlights.title: New Constraints on $r$-process Nucleosynthesis in Neutron Star Mergers from GW170817 Late-Phase Spectra
highlights.reason: 论文直接研究中子星并合事件GW170817对应千新星AT2017gfo的晚期光谱，并给出r过程元素丰度和未检出元素的定量约束，与中子星并合、r过程核合成及光谱诊断方向高度相关。

highlights.title: Not So Heavy Metal I: Low Metallicity Enhances the Rate of high-redshift Superluminous Supernovae
highlights.reason: 研究低金属丰度如何影响高红移超亮超新星发生率，与超新星及其可能的中心引擎研究有实质关联；但材料未显示其直接研究 FRB、致密天体高能观测或喷流。

highlights.title: How collective modes terminate in the dispersion relation of neutrino plasmas
highlights.reason: 与研究组的中微子方向有实质联系：论文研究超新星和中子星并合环境中集体味波的线性色散结构，提供区分真实模式终止、简并和数值求根伪象的理论判据，并检验非零质量及连续能谱对模式结构的影响。其效用主要在中微子味演化理论与计算方法，给定材料未建立这些奇点与可观测高能信号的定量联系，因此建议作为相关理论工作了解，而非列为核心观测方向的必读论文。

highlights.title: Cosmic-neighbor-associated distances to VHE and candidate VHE BL Lacs via SDSS photometric redshifts
highlights.reason: 研究甚高能 BL Lac 的距离估计，与高能天体观测有一定关联；但主题是耀变体红移和周围星系结构，而非研究组的核心瞬变方向。

highlights.title: NEXUS: Discovery of a Luminous Young Transient at $z=5$
highlights.reason: 研究高红移核心塌缩超新星候选体的早期紫外发射，并讨论冲击冷却与周星物质相互作用等可能的额外能量来源；与激波及周星介质方向有实质联系，但事件分类和物理解释仍受单历元数据限制。

highlights.title: Angular structure of finite-field vacuum birefringence in magnetars
highlights.reason: 与研究组的磁星及致密天体高能偏振观测有实质联系：论文量化强磁场真空双折射角度因子近似的误差，并提供可用于偏振输运实现的解析基准。其效用主要是改进真空响应建模和明确精度边界；并未计算完整的可观测偏振，也未直接研究 FRB/PRS、爆发中心引擎或周星介质，因此建议作为相关方法论文了解，而非核心必读。

highlights.title: HLX-1 as a Repeating Partial Tidal Disruption Event around an Intermediate-Mass Black Hole
highlights.reason: 论文研究 HLX–1 的重复部分潮汐瓦解解释，与高能瞬变和致密天体吸积有相关性；但现有证据也显示若干历元的约束较弱，整体更适合作为相关进展了解。

entries.title: Not So Heavy Metal I: Low Metallicity Enhances the Rate of high-redshift Superluminous Supernovae
entries.abstract: Type-I superluminous supernovae (SLSNe) are extremely luminous stellar explosions originating from the core collapse of massive stars. Unlike normal core-collapse supernovae, however, SLSNe occur almost exclusively in metal-poor environments. As a result, their volumetric rate should not simply trace the cosmic star-formation history, but instead evolve with the metallicity distribution of galaxies across cosmic time. In this work, we introduce a new theoretical framework for modeling the volumetric rate of astrophysical sources as a function of redshift and metallicity. Our formalism combines metallicity scaling relations, stellar-mass distribution functions, and metallicity-dependent production efficiencies. Importantly, it also distinguishes between metallicity measures based on O/H and Fe/H abundances. Applying our new formalism to SLSNe, we predict volumetric rates that are nearly an order of magnitude higher at $z \gtrsim 2$ compared to models in which the rate traces the cosmic star-formation rate alone. This has direct implications on the detection prospects of high-$z$ SLSNe with the Vera C. Rubin Observatory and other time-domain surveys.

entries.title: Nearby Supernova Science in the Era of High Cadence, Deep Time Domain Surveys
entries.abstract: We discuss science opportunities for nearby supernovae (SNe) in the era of the Vera C. Rubin Observatory's Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST), emphasizing the youngest phases of SN evolution and the value of contemporaneous high-cadence shadowing surveys. LSST's Wide Fast Deep survey will discover enormous numbers of SNe, but its $\sim 3$ day cadence will miss signatures that evolve on timescales of hours to days, requiring cadence augmentation by other programs. We present simple depth and cadence metrics for early SN signatures and use empirical nearby SN discovery rates to estimate the resulting science opportunities. LSST will detect or set limits on precursor emission from hundreds of core-collapse SNe, including $\gtrsim 50$-100 Type IIn and normal Type II SNe annually, as well as $\gtrsim$5 Type Ibn. Within $\sim 200$ Mpc, roughly 250 Type Ia SNe are classified annually, providing the potential to identify hundreds of early light-curve excesses, and a robust measurement of the incidence of extreme high-velocity features ($>$25,000 km s$^{-1}$). A shadowing survey with a depth of $\sim 22.5$ mag could search for early light-curve features, akin to the light-curve excess seen in SN2023ixf, across dozens of nearby core-collapse SNe every year. Rapid spectroscopy of $\gtrsim$150 Type II SNe per year within $\sim$160 Mpc could constrain the incidence of short-lived flash features to $\lesssim$10% within a few years, while also tying this to the rate of precursor emission in normal Type II SNe. We also discuss the challenges posed by early classification ambiguity and faint nonterminal transients, and we request that the 80 hour embargo on LSST images be waived for nearby galaxy fields. Finally, we advocate for a Nearby Galaxy Transient Broker that integrates transient streams, archival data, forced photometry, and follow-up triggering in a single platform.

entries.title: Testing Offsets Between Cluster-Scale Halos and BCGs in Strong Lensing Models Using the Jackknife Method
entries.abstract: Offsets between cluster-scale dark matter halos and brightest cluster galaxies (BCGs) inferred from strong lensing (SL) models have been used to investigate cluster dynamics and dark matter physics. However, it is necessary to test whether these offsets are required by SL data themselves. We investigate whether allowing these offsets improves predictive accuracy and examine the effects on magnification, time-delay predictions, and critical curve positions. We evaluate lens models of Abell 370, RX J1347.5-1145, and MACS J0416.1-2403 using the jackknife method, which assesses predictions for source systems excluded from the lens reconstruction. Models are constructed with MrMARTIAN, which combines analytic mass profiles with a regularized grid that represents mass structure not captured by the profiles. We compare fixed and free halo position models across regularization weights. The root mean square values averaged over excluded systems agree within bootstrap uncertainties, while the median paired differences remain close to zero across all three clusters and tested regularization weights. These results indicate comparable predictive accuracy between the fixed and free models. The total mass distributions remain broadly similar, although the magnitudes of fitted halo offsets vary with regularization, showing that the mass decomposition is not unique. For these three clusters, offsets between BCGs and cluster-scale halos in the lens models are not required by the SL data to improve predictive accuracy within the MrMARTIAN framework. The mass decomposition between the regularized grid and cluster-scale halos is not uniquely determined. These findings limit physical interpretations based on fitted halo positions alone. The model dependence of magnification and time-delay estimation can also affect the inferred intrinsic properties of high-redshift sources or the Hubble constant.

entries.title: How collective modes terminate in the dispersion relation of neutrino plasmas
entries.abstract: Neutrino plasmas support flavor waves, collective oscillations of flavor, that neutrinos can resonantly emit or absorb when they fulfill the Cherenkov condition. For massless neutrinos, this condition leads to singular features in the dispersion relation: Landau-damped modes, for example, disappear abruptly as their phase velocity approaches the speed of light. We investigate how these singularities change when nonzero neutrino masses introduce a spread in velocities. We classify singular behavior of the frequency as a function of wavevector into i) degeneracy points, where two modes merge, and ii) abrupt mode termination, when the frequency approaches a branch cut of the flavor dielectric function. For each class, we derive a local expansion and determine where such behavior can occur. Degeneracy points, frequently encountered in axially symmetric dispersion relations in the fast limit, are not generic. Nonzero neutrino masses lift the degeneracy along the symmetry axis; in three-dimensional wavevector space, there might still be degeneracy lines, not necessarily intersecting the symmetry axis. Abrupt mode termination, instead, persists generically, except for special energy distributions which are entire functions. As a byproduct of this study, we show that a collisionless plasma with a Lorentzian neutrino-frequency distribution is exactly equivalent to a monochromatic one with an effective collision rate. Approximating a general frequency distribution by a sum of Lorentzians therefore substantially simplifies the dispersion relation.

entries.title: Surveying for Close Binaries among Lithium-rich Giants
entries.abstract: One of the possible scenarios usually considered to explain the existence of low-mass red giants with anomalously high lithium (Li) abundances requires the interaction with a close binary companion. If dominant, this enrichment channel predicts a significantly enhanced binary fraction among Li-rich giants relative to Li-normal ones. We aim to constrain the binary interaction hypothesis by using multi-epoch radial velocities (RVs) to measure the close binary fraction of a statistically robust sample of Li-rich giants. We are surveying both red clump (RC) and first ascent red giant (RGB) targets, which allows us to examine potential differences in the binary fraction as a function of evolutionary stage. We are monitoring 70 targets (40 RC and 30 RGB, all Li-rich) using ESPRESSO at the VLT, 57 of which (32 RC + 25 RGB) already have 4 or more visits over a $\sim$7 month baseline; the analysis in this paper is based on the latter. For the targets with RV variation larger than that expected for intrinsic jitter, we use a Monte Carlo analysis to estimate the probability that the observed RV variation is due to a stellar ($P_{SB}$) or sub-stellar ($P_{SS}$) companion. Discounting the 38 targets consistent with stellar jitter, we are left with 11 RC and 8 RGB stars (34% and 32% of the respective sub-samples) with RV variability consistent with the presence of a close companion with an orbital period shorter than 3000 days. Of these 19, 3 can be confirmed as stellar-mass companions. The distributions of $P_{SB}$ and $P_{SS}$ are statistically indistinguishable between the RC and RGB samples. We thus find no evidence so far in our current data for a binary fraction for Li-rich giants (in either evolutionary stage) larger than that expected for a Li-normal population. Extending the RV baseline to probe longer orbital periods will be important to keep exploring the plausibility of this scenario.

entries.title: An X-ray Extremely wide-field Spectroscopic Surveyor (XESS, or "chess")
entries.abstract: We propose an X-ray observatory, the X-ray Extremely wide-field Spectroscopic Surveyor (XESS, pronounced "Chess") to bring high energy resolution X-ray spectroscopy into the era of synoptic surveys and of time domain and multi-messenger astrophysics (TDAMM). Such an observatory is optimally suited to addressing key elements of the 2020 Decadal Survey on Astronomy and Astrophysics.

entries.title: Revealing the accretion disc structure in Changing State AGN: NGC1566
entries.abstract: NGC1566 is a low mass ($\sim 6\times 10^6M_\odot$) Active Galactic Nuclei (AGN) with unusual large amplitude variabilty in its accretion flow. In the optical it cycles between recurring short bright episodes with strong blue/UV continuum and clear broad line emission, and a much weaker persistent level without strong broad lines, making it a repeating changing-state (CS) AGN. We re-analyse the intensive optical/UV and X-ray monitoring during the 2018 bright flare, showing for the first time the corresponding evolution of the (host galaxy subtracted) optical/UV AGN spectrum as well as the X-ray emission. As seen in other CS-AGN, the strongest spectral evolution is in a UV/soft X-ray component which likely disappears below $0.01L_{\rm Edd}$ while the hot corona and a redder optical/UV component show weaker variability. We show that the red optical emission is likely a composite of the intrinsic and reprocessed emission from the outer disc, together with diffuse continuum from the BLR, and discuss the different signatures predicted by this for continuum reverberation across the changing-state event. The historical lightcurves show repeated changing-state events tied to unusually large amplitude discrete flares in the lightcurve. While these do not appear to be periodic, the behaviour does support previous suggestions that the accretion flow is repeatedly perturbed, perhaps by an intermediate mass black hole companion.

entries.title: Learning Gaia: A Generative Model Trained on the Gaia Data Release 3 Source Catalog
entries.abstract: I train a conditional flow matching model on the positions, photometry, and astrometry of $\sim$ 579 million sources from the Gaia Data Release 3 Source Catalog. Using a probabilistic masking scheme during training, I develop a model capable of generating mock Gaia catalog sources with and without partial measurements of real Gaia sources. The model can produce coarse-grained mock Gaia Source Catalogs that reproduce the Milky Way disk and Magellanic Clouds, and can impute photometric and kinematic information. The model fails to reproduce small, distinct subpopulations like $ω$ Centauri. This model is a necessary step towards a foundation model trained on the entirety of Gaia data products, and provides a blueprint for future work with the upcoming Gaia Data Release 4.

entries.title: Cosmic-neighbor-associated distances to VHE and candidate VHE BL Lacs via SDSS photometric redshifts
entries.abstract: BL Lac objects have distances that are difficult to estimate because their optical spectra rarely show identifiable emission or absorption lines. We present a method to constrain BL Lac distances by associating them with their cosmic neighborhoods (local overdensities in the cosmic web) identified in optical fields. Distances to galaxies in these neighborhoods are estimated using the Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) photometric redshifts. Using cosmic-neighborhood associations previously established from multi-object spectroscopy and BL Lacs with spectroscopically measured redshifts as control samples, we find that the redshifts of the associated neighborhoods can be recovered with an accuracy of $Δz \sim 0.02-0.04$. When multiple candidate neighborhoods are present in the field, we rank the candidate associations using a central-location criterion. In 50% of cases, the BL Lac is associated with the correct neighborhood. We provide distance estimates for BL Lac objects without secure redshift measurements, focusing on sources detected at very high energies (VHE; $E>100$,GeV) and on candidate VHE emitters. Combining intervening absorption systems, host-galaxy imaging, $γ$-ray constraints, and our SDSS group-association method, we propose likely redshifts for TXS 0141$+$268 ($z\sim0.93-0.95$), PKS 0735$+$178 ($z=0.64$), 3FHL J0905.5$+$1357 ($z=0.644$), B2 0912$+$29 ($z = 0.53$), 3FHL J1120.8$+$4212 ($z=0.363$), BZB J1243$+$3627 ($z=0.485$), 3FHL J1253.1$+$5300 ($z=0.664$), and RX J2156.0$+$1818 ($z=0.635$). Finally, we discuss how forthcoming narrow-band photometric-redshift surveys can improve blazar distance estimates via group-association techniques.

entries.title: HESS J1507-622: A Plausible Young Galactic Kilonova Remnant
entries.abstract: HESS J1507$-$622 is an unusual TeV gamma-ray source in the H.E.S.S. Galactic Plane Survey, distinguished by its off-plane location ($b \simeq -3.5^{\circ}$) and compact angular extent ($\sim 0.3^{\circ}$). Its location and morphology challenge conventional pulsar wind nebula and supernova remnant interpretations, and the absence of a detected shell or associated pulsar leaves its origin unresolved. Here, we propose that HESS J1507$-$622 is a young Galactic kilonova remnant with gamma-ray emission of leptonic origin. In this scenario, the source's off-plane location is naturally explained by the natal kick imparted to the progenitor binary neutron star system. We demonstrate that a leptonic kilonova remnant model can successfully reproduce the observed GeV-TeV flux via inverse-Compton scattering from shock-accelerated electrons, while the corresponding synchrotron emission remains below current X-ray and radio upper limits. Based on the source's energetics and angular size, we infer a distance of 3.8-14.3 kpc and an age of 0.2-3.0 kyr. Importantly, our analysis favors a kilonova remnant younger than 1 kyr. The lack of a historical naked-eye record can be explained by the transient's rapid fading, far-southern declination, and potential line-of-sight extinction. We further assess the detectability of unique multi-wavelength signatures that could confirm this hypothesis. We find promising prospects for detecting the unique MeV gamma rays from the decay of $r$-process radioisotopes using future observatories, alongside complementary low-energy signatures from thermal dust emission and a possible optical light echo. These distinct signals offer definitive tests of the kilonova remnant interpretation and motivate targeted observations with current and future facilities.

entries.title: VLBI Astrometric Procedure and Performance with CHIME/FRB Outriggers
entries.abstract: Precise localizations of fast radio bursts (FRBs) to specific environments within their host galaxies with very-long-baseline interferometry (VLBI) have provided valuable insights into the nature of their progenitors. To date, such localizations have relied primarily on traditional VLBI facilities, whose observational capabilities limit them to targeted follow-up on a small subset of repeating FRBs that are observable at frequencies above $\sim$1 GHz. CHIME/FRB Outriggers is a low-frequency (400--800 MHz), wide-field VLBI network designed to overcome these limitations, aiming to localize a substantial fraction of CHIME-detected FRBs to $\sim$50 mas precision. In this work, we detail the analysis procedure used to localize FRBs with the CHIME/FRB Outriggers VLBI array. With over a thousand test localizations consisting of continuum calibrators and pulsars with known VLBI positions, we provide a comprehensive demonstration of the VLBI array's ability to robustly meet, and under some conditions exceed, the nominal astrometric specification required for the central science goals of CHIME/FRB Outriggers. By demonstrating that a wide-field survey instrument can deliver routine $\sim$50 mas astrometry on one-off FRBs, this work lays the foundation for the upcoming generation of wide-field VLBI FRB surveys and the population-scale FRB samples they will enable.

entries.title: A New Hope for AGN SED Fitting: X-Ray Spectral Analysis of 12MGS AGN with the C2PO-Torus Model
entries.abstract: In this paper, we present the results of comprehensive, broadband X-ray spectral analysis of a subsample of 43 mid-Infrared (IR) selected star-forming active galactic nuclei (AGN). We analysed archival NuSTAR, Chandra, and XMM-Newton data, and present the first pointed X-ray observation of IRASF03450+0055. We introduce a new physically-based X-ray spectral model, C2PO-Torus, based on a two-phase clumpy torus geometry. It is designed to provide constraints on physical parameters of the torus that can be directly linked to the parameters of the AGN model SKIRTOR. This model will allow us to exploit the synergies between the X-ray and IR regimes, place stronger constraints on the torus properties, and improve spectral energy distribution (SED) fitting by providing priors for the SKIRTOR parameters. We compare the results from the C2PO-Torus fitting to those obtained from traditional models, finding that it is an extremely effective tool for fitting a wide variety of X-ray spectra. We observe that our sample closely follows the established L_[OIII] - L_X AGN relation, while presenting an IR and Radio excess with respect to the L_X - L_12micron and L_X - L_1.4GHz AGN relations at low luminosities. We believe that this excess is due to contamination from star formation related emission. We anticipate that the C2PO-Torus model will aid substantially in completing full-spectrum SED fitting of this sample, allowing us to properly disentangle the different emission components of these objects, which are local analogues of AGN at Cosmic Noon.

entries.title: NEXUS: Discovery of a Luminous Young Transient at $z=5$
entries.abstract: We report the discovery of AT 2026abck, a young transient in a star-forming galaxy at $z=5.017\pm0.001$, identified from Year-2 observations of the NEXUS JWST treasury program. AT 2026abck was detected on 2026 Aug 7 in NIRCam F200W imaging, with contemporaneous detection from parallel NIRCam F150W+F277W imaging. It brightened by $>1.4$ mag in F200W over $\lesssim 12$ rest-frame days, as inferred from the last non-detection. AT 2026abck has nearly identical magnitudes of $\sim27.4$ mag in F150W, F200W, and F277W, and is undetected in F444W ($>27.9$ mag, 3$σ$). It is the first robustly detected $z\gtrsim 5$ transient in a non-lensing field. A blackbody fit yields a hot photosphere ($\sim1.7\times10^4\, \mathrm{K}$) with a radius of $\sim7\times10^{14}$ cm ($\sim46$ au) and a bolometric luminosity of $\sim3\times10^{43}\, {\rm erg\, s^{-1}}$. Its off-nucleus location and hot, UV-bright SED favor a core-collapse supernova origin, while its temperature and luminosity exceed those of normal SNe II at comparable early phases. We estimate that AT 2026abck was detected $\sim4$-10 rest-frame days after explosion. The host is an intermediate-mass ($M_*\approx10^{9.8}\,M_\odot$), star-forming (${\rm SFR}\approx20\,M_\odot\,{\rm yr^{-1}}$) galaxy on the $z\approx5$ main sequence, $\sim3.3$ dex more massive than the ultra-faint host of the lensed SN Eos at $z=5.13$. Together, the two events show that CCSNe at $z>5$ occur across a wide range of host environments, and AT 2026abck demonstrates that high-cadence blank-field JWST surveys can capture high-redshift SNe during their early, UV-bright phase.

entries.title: Cosmic Collisions I: Optical Morphologies for MIRI-selected galaxies from the PRIMER survey
entries.abstract: We present the first results of visual morphology classifications from the Cosmic Collisions project, comprising 14,657 galaxies from the JWST Public Release IMaging for Extragalactic Research (PRIMER) survey. The sample consists of galaxies detected with MIRI F770W and spans the epoch of peak cosmic star formation (1<z<3). We produce rest-frame optical and observed-frame mid-IR images and enlisted citizen science volunteers through the Zooniverse platform to classify galaxy morphology, surface features, and interactions. The project accumulated 304,524 classifications from more than 4,700 volunteers. We find that mid-IR selected galaxies have significantly different morphologies relative to optical and near-IR selected galaxies, favoring dust-rich disk galaxies at z<2 and compact systems at z>2. This inverts findings from optical selection, which shows galaxies becoming more bulge-dominated and elliptical over cosmic time. In addition, we identify a population of galaxies with disk-like optical morphologies and luminous mid-IR point-source cores that may represent obscured AGN candidates, offering a promising path to identify AGNs based on imaging alone. Comparison with visual classifications from HST imaging demonstrates the impact of JWST's improved sensitivity and resolution on the identification of galaxy structure and interactions, with systems previously identified by HST as compact, smooth, or featureless showing significant extended and internal structure in JWST. These results provide a foundation for future investigations into the connection between morphology, dust structure, star formation, and AGN activity.

entries.title: Relativistic Spherical Accretion in Nonrotating Black Hole Spacetimes: Astrophysical Implications
entries.abstract: We present a systematic analysis of spherically symmetric accretion flows onto thirteen non-rotating black hole spacetimes, including charged and regular black holes, scalar and dilaton fields, dark energy, cosmological constants, modified gravity, and parametrized metrics. We generalize the Michel solution to arbitrary diagonal spacetimes and investigate the density, temperature, velocity, Mach number, mass accretion rate, and bremsstrahlung luminosity equilibrium profiles. Using the Schwarzschild solution as a reference, we find significant deviations in the accretion flow, with cosmological-constant and dark-energy models strongly suppressing accretion, while regular and Yukawa-like spacetimes generally enhance it. We provide fitting formulas for the accretion rates and luminosities as functions of the spacetime parameters. We then explore two astrophysical applications: accretion onto supermassive black holes, such as Sgr A* and M87*, and the inferred progenitor masses of the intermediate-mass black holes associated with the GW190521 gravitational wave event. We find that observational uncertainties may allow us to probe signatures of deviations from the Schwarzschild spacetime.

entries.title: A triple-induced merger in T Ori C, solves the proplyd lifetime problem and the curiously young shell of M42
entries.abstract: There has long been a tension between the stellar ages in the Orion Nebula Cluster and the rapid external photoevaporation of its protoplanetary discs. Recently, the shell of the Orion Nebula has similarly been found to be dynamically younger than the stars. We propose a new scenario to resolve both age problems. In our scenario the ONC's most massive star, $θ^1$~Ori~C1, formed from the merger between two binary stars induced by vZLK oscillations due to the present-day binary companion $θ^1$~Ori~C2. This merger, happening between the last episode of star formation and today, resulted in an increased luminosity, leading to stronger external photoevaporation and accelerated expansion of the shell. {We use Monte Carlo simulations to explore both whether a sudden brightening of $θ^1$~Ori~C1 could reconcile the stellar ages and shell expansion, and whether triple progenitors to $θ^1$~Ori~C\, could result in stellar mergers on the relevant timescale. A sudden brightening of $θ^1$~Ori~C1 a few hundred thousand years ago can reproduce today's shell while maintaining a system age close to the stellar age. However, the required increase in stellar wind luminosity is greater than a simple merger can explain. At lower luminosity, the mixing of a relatively greater amount of cool photoevaporative wind material into the hot bubble could result in the required increase, and we identify a lower limit on the required strength of this effect. Additionally, we find that progenitor triples merge readily, on timescales even shorter than the scenario would require. These mergers could be deferred by increased pre-main sequence tidal effects, rotation, and perturbing encounters with other cluster members. Our proposed scenario with a merger driven by von Zeipel-Lidov-Kozai evolution solves two problems; the Orion Nebula's proplyd problem and the shell lifetime problems.

entries.title: Nonthermal hotspot orbiting the supermassive black hole Sgr A*
entries.abstract: Recent millimeter wavelength observations at 230 GHz by the Event Horizon Telescope have resolved the innermost structure of the Galactic Center, Sgr A*, revealing a ring-like structure consistent with synchrotron emission from a magnetized torus surrounding a supermassive black hole. These observations reveal two key features: three prominent hotspots near the photon ring and low light-curve variability, with a modulation index of $\barσ/\barμ \lesssim 0.1$. State-of-the-art general relativistic magnetohydrodynamic and radiative transfer simulations cannot simultaneously reproduce the three hotspots and low light-curve variability observed in Sgr A*. We propose that an orbiting hot blob, formed in the accretion disk, could account for hotspots. We systematically explore its physical properties, including size, emission amplitude, orbital radius, eccentricity, velocity, and orbital plane orientation. The results -- applying two observational constraints--show that the preferred model corresponds to a black hole with dimensionless spin $a_{\star}=0.5$, a magnetically arrested disk configuration for the magnetic field, and the presence of a hotspot with size $σ_{\rm hs}=2\,M$ and intensity amplitude $A=10$, orbiting circularly at $r_{\rm orb}=6 M$ with Keplerian velocity in the black holes equatorial plane, and an inclination view angle of $i^\circ=20$.

entries.title: Angular structure of finite-field vacuum birefringence in magnetars
entries.abstract: Vacuum birefringence in a strong magnetic field is often modelled by combining the finite-field splitting for perpendicular propagation with the familiar $\sin^2θ$ angular factor. That separation is exact only at leading response order. Continuing our previous study of the field-strength dependence of the birefringence, we examine the angular dependence of the full one-loop refractive indices in the local Heisenberg--Euler theory. We show analytically that, on the positive-birefringence branch, the usual factorized form systematically overestimates the exact splitting away from perpendicular propagation. The relative correction is largest close to the magnetic-field direction, where the absolute birefringence itself vanishes. Compact analytic expansions expose the sign, scaling, and angular location of the correction throughout the magnetar-relevant range $B/B_{\rm cr}\le100$, while an independent proper-time calculation verifies the underlying one-loop coefficients. In centred-dipole applications the correction is sub-percent for moderate magnetar fields but reaches several percent for the strongest sources; surface averaging and radial phase accumulation reduce its physical weight as the field decreases away from the stellar surface. The result separates finite-field amplitude and angular corrections and provides controlled analytic benchmarks for precision polarization transport in strongly magnetized environments.

entries.title: Sunrise III/SUSI reveals extended and spectrally structured Ca II K emission above the solar limb
entries.abstract: The Sunrise III/SUSI instrument performed a sit-and-stare observation of the off-limb emission in the Ca II K line core, with a combination of excellent temporal and spectral resolution. The emission reaches up to 6 Mm above the solar limb, indicating the existence of off-limb structures akin to spicules. In this letter, we describe the spatio-spectral properties of the observed emission, focusing on the spectral line shape resolved in detail by Sunrise III/SUSI, and compare the observation with simple modeling that relies on a numerical simulation of the solar chromosphere. We find that the simulation contains enough cool and dense material at Mm heights to produce off-limb emission, but that the spectral width of these features is slightly lower than observed, necessitating more detailed modeling.

entries.title: Chandra X-ray Spectral Evidence of the Dual AGN Nature of the Gravitational lens MG B2016+112 at z=3.273 with 175 pc separation
entries.abstract: We use a new 175 ks Chandra X-ray observation of the z=3.273 radio-loud gravitational lens system MG B2016+112 to present definitive X-ray spectral evidence that it contains a dual active galactic nucleus (AGN). With a projected separation of 175 parsecs, this is the tightest separation confirmed AGN pair at high redshift. Prior multi-epoch very long baseline interferometry (VLBI) and archival Chandra data had revealed two distinct emitters, but could not rule out a single AGN with a complex, highly magnified jet. Our new Chandra observations allow a separate spectral analysis of each source. We find strong intrinsic absorption (N_H > 4 x 10^22 cm^-2, 3 sigma confidence) at the source redshift for the highly magnified source inside the caustic. This identifies it as an obscured AGN. In addition to the previously known type II AGN outside the caustic, this confirms a compact dual AGN system in MG B2016+112. On-going and future surveys using facilities such as Euclid, SKA, and the Rubin and Roman observatories will uncover more such systems, probing SMBH evolution and gravitational wave precursors.

entries.title: New Constraints on $r$-process Nucleosynthesis in Neutron Star Mergers from GW170817 Late-Phase Spectra
entries.abstract: The neutron star merger event GW170817 provided the first direct evidence of $r$-process nucleosynthesis. Observed spectra of its electromagnetic counterpart AT2017gfo exhibited several features that encode information on the nature and abundance of the synthesized $r$-process elements. In this study, we investigate the late nebular-phase spectral features of AT2017gfo, which provide important probes of the elemental abundance of the ejecta. We construct an analytic spectral model that computes emission features produced by the radiative decay of collisionally excited ions through allowed and forbidden transitions. By comparing our model to AT2017gfo, we identify La III and Ce III as the main contributors to the emission features at $1.4\,μ{\rm m}$ and $1.6\,μ{\rm m}$, respectively. We also confirm Te III as the dominant contributor to the $2.1\,μ{\rm m}$ feature proposed in previous works. We infer mass fractions of $X({\rm La})\approx 0.025-0.05$, $X({\rm Ce})\approx 0.05-0.1$, and $X({\rm Te})\approx 0.04-0.08$, although the La and Ce abundance estimates remain tentative due to uncertainties in the radiation field. From the non-detections of Kr and Sb lines, we derive upper limits of $X({\rm Kr})\lesssim 0.03$ and $X({\rm Sb})\lesssim 0.003$. These results suggest that nucleosynthesis in the inner ejecta of GW170817 produced a suppressed first $r$-process peak and an enhanced heavy-element abundance compared to the solar $r$-process pattern, with an estimated lanthanide fraction of $X_{\rm LN}\approx (3-6) \times 10^{-2}$. Our conclusions are consistent with the apparent universality of heavy $r$-process elements and the lanthanide fraction inferred from observations of $r$-enhanced metal-poor stars.

entries.title: HLX-1 as a Repeating Partial Tidal Disruption Event around an Intermediate-Mass Black Hole
entries.abstract: ESO 243$-$49 HLX--1 is one of the first known compelling intermediate-mass black hole (IMBH) candidates, but the origin of its recurrent X-ray outbursts remains unsettled. In this work we fit the HLX--1 outbursts simultaneously with a relativistic thin-disk time-dependent model. The black-hole and disk-geometry parameters are tied across epochs, while the injected mass and timing parameters are fitted separately for each outburst. We also include a contemporaneous \textit{HST} UV/optical/IR spectral energy distribution obtained near the peak of one outburst, which constrains the global temperature and radius scales of the disk. The soft-state data are consistent with a common global solution, with black hole mass $\log_{10}(M_{\bullet}/M_\odot)=4.5\pm0.2$ and disk formation radius $\log_{10}(r_0/r_g)=3.8\pm0.3$. The differences between outbursts are mainly described by modest changes in disk mass and viscous timescales. The inferred injected masses are typically $\sim 10^{-3}\,M_\odot$ per outburst, requiring a total fuel supply of at least a few $\times 10^{-3}\,M_\odot$ across the observed sequence. This mass scale, and the disk size, are consistent with repeated partial stripping of a low-mass donor. A simple Keplerian mapping of the flare gaps and fitted disk radius implies a highly eccentric orbit with a pericenter just outside the donor's tidal radius. These results support a repeating partial tidal disruption interpretation for the origin of HLX--1.

entries.title: Magnetic field diagnostics of a solar active region filament
entries.abstract: We performed spectropolarimetric observations of an active region filament in He I 10830 angstrom and Si I 10827 angstrom lines to investigate its magnetic field structure. We carried out full-Stokes inversions with the HAZEL code, which takes into account the Zeeman and Hanle effects. As a result, we yielded a mean field strength of 101 $\pm$ 33 G and a horizontal field nearly parallel to the filament axis, such that the distinction between the two classical normal- and reverse-polarity models becomes physically insignificant. In addition, we found Zeeman-like signatures in the linear polarization, characterized by double-peaked symmetric profiles, in some pixels of our observations. Since these profiles could not be well reproduced by modeling that included both the Zeeman and Hanle effects, we performed inversions assuming only the Zeeman effect. The inversion yielded a strong magnetic field of approximately 500 G. However, simultaneous observations of Si I 10827 angstrom indicate a photospheric magnetic field weaker than 100 G. Therefore, the scenario proposed by Diaz Baso et al. (2016), in which the strong field inferred from He I 10830 angstrom originates from contamination by the underlying photosphere, does not apply to our filament. The Zeeman-like profiles are preferentially found in optically thick regions ($τ$ ~ 1.4-2.5), where the simplifying assumptions adopted in HAZEL are expected to become less reliable. Our results suggest that these profiles reveal limitations of the current inversion framework in optically thick regions and motivate future radiative-transfer modeling incorporating self-consistent radiation fields, differential illumination of the multiplet components, and possibly partial frequency redistribution.

entries.title: Pulsar glitches triggered by quakes when stress reaches a threshold
entries.abstract: The starquake model of pulsar glitches is revisited in light of accumulated observational data. A statistical comparison between the time-predictable and the magnitude-predictable models, borrowed from seismology and grounded in the classical spring-slider framework, is performed against a sample of 245 glitch events from 9 pulsars. It is found that the data supports the time-predictable model, i.e., a quake resulting in a glitch could be triggered when the developed stress reaches a critical threshold, $τ_{\rm c}$, while the remaining elastic energy (correspondingly the residual stress, $τ_{\rm r}$) after quakes is not fixed. The critical stress could be the order of $τ_{\rm c}\simeq (10^{34}-10^{35})\ {\rm dyn\,cm^{-2}}$ if the residual stress after a quake with maximum stress drops could be considered negligible (i.e., $τ_{\rm r}\simeq 0$), to explain the glitch amplitudes and the intervals. This $τ_{\rm c}$-value is the order of the shear modulus of strangeon stars, but would be several orders higher than that of conventional neutron stars.

entries.title: The impact of the turbulent Mach number on star formation and the initial mass function
entries.abstract: Turbulence regulates star formation by influencing the density structure and fragmentation of molecular clouds, and therefore it is expected to play a key role in setting the initial mass function (IMF). We study how the strength of the turbulent shocks affects star formation and the IMF by comparing a series of magnetohydrodynamical (MHD) simulations of star cluster formation in clouds with three different rms Mach number values, $M=2.5, 5$, and $10$, but otherwise the same Alfvén Mach number ($M_\mathrm{A}\sim3$) and virial parameter ($α_\mathrm{vir}\sim0.5$). All three simulations include stellar feedback in the form of protostellar jets/outflows and accretion heating. We find that the star formation rate per freefall time ($\mathrm{SFR_{ff}}$) for the $M=10$ model is higher by a factor of $\sim3$ compared to the $M=2.5$ and $5$ cases, which have similar $\mathrm{SFR_{ff}}$. In terms of the IMF, the $M=5$ and $10$ models produce almost similar distributions, resembling typical observed IMFs. The $M=2.5$ model, on the other hand, produces a bimodal IMF with a primary peak at supersolar masses ($\sim 2\, \mathrm{M_\odot}$) and a secondary peak in the substellar regime ($< 0.1\, \mathrm{M_\odot}$). The $M=2.5$ and $5$ simulations producing significantly different IMFs while having similar $\mathrm{SFR_{ff}}$, suggest that a distinct set of physical processes governs the SFR and IMF. Through a resolution study for the $M=2.5$ case, we find our base models have reached near numerical convergence, potentially only slightly underestimating close-binary formation. We also see signatures of bimodality in the $M=2.5$ model for the multiplicity fraction and stellar angular momentum distribution.

entries.title: The "Fork" Geometry in the DESI Main Survey DR1: Implications of Target Selection for Galaxy Evolution Studies
entries.abstract: The Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) Main Survey Data Release 1 (DR1) provides an unprecedented spectroscopic view of galaxies and quasars across a large fraction of the observable Universe. However, the survey's tracer-dependent targeting strategy introduces complex observational selection effects that strongly influence the apparent distribution of galaxies in the redshift-luminosity plane. In this work, we investigate the origin of the characteristic "fork" geometry observed in DESI DR1 and show that the observed distribution is consistent with an interpretation in which it arises from the combined action of intrinsic galaxy bimodality and the survey's redshift-dependent selection function. We show that the observed underdensity separating the dominant galaxy populations is influenced not only by the physical Green Valley but also by survey selection effects, since it is further shaped by magnitude limits, surface-brightness selection, and structural incompleteness. Using DESI DR1 spectroscopy together with Legacy Survey photometry, we analyze the roles of the BGS, LRG, ELG, and QSO target classes in producing the observed distribution and assess their impact on luminosity-function measurements. Our results indicate that both target selection and observational biases significantly affect the observed galaxy distribution and the evolutionary trends inferred from it. We summarize practical observational considerations aimed at minimizing these effects and enabling more robust studies of galaxy evolution with DESI.

entries.title: Stacked strong and weak lensing united: Improved measurement of the stellar and dark matter distributions in massive early-type galaxies at $z\sim 0.5$
entries.abstract: We present a new measurement of the stellar and dark matter distributions in massive early-type galaxies at redshift $0.4<z<0.6$ by combining stacked strong and weak lensing measurements. The stacked weak lensing measurements down to the small radius of $0.013\,\mathrm{Mpc}/h$ enabled by the Subaru Telescope Hyper Suprime-Cam data are combined with stacked enclosed projected mass measurements from 13 strong lens systems. We find that adding strong lensing constraints improves constraints on the stellar and dark matter distributions. The central dark matter profile is found to be consistent with the standard Navarro-Frenk-White density profile. The stellar initial mass function is found to be bottom-heavy. The total density profile in the inner region is described well by the power-law density profile with the slope of $-1.96\pm 0.07$, which can also explain weak lensing signals out to $1\,\mathrm{Mpc}/h$ reasonably well. The stacked weak lensing profile constrains an internal mass-sheet transformation parameter to $λ_{\mathrm{c}}=0.978\pm0.010$. Our analysis demonstrates that the combination of the stacked strong and weak lensing serves as a powerful tool for studying central density profiles of galaxies.

entries.title: Improved Population and EOS Joint Inference for Binary Neutron Star Systems
entries.abstract: The extreme environment within neutron stars presents the opportunity to probe the nuclear equation of state at high densities while studying the properties of these stellar remnants. Historically, the equation of state and neutron star mass distribution have been inferred separately, with the latter often simply assumed to be fixed in studies of the former, but the dependence of the equation of state on neutron star mass indicates they should be inferred together. In this work, we extend the generalized version of the popular RIFT algorithm known as Hyperpipe to interface with flexible, user-provided priors that will facilitate joint inference of equation of state and binary neutron star population hyperparameters. We demonstrate this framework's utility via application to a combination of several existing observations, particularly including massive galactic pulsars, double neutron star systems, millisecond X-ray pulsars, the gravitational wave event GW170817 and the nuclear symmetry energy, within the context of a widely-adopted parametric EOS family and a simple Gaussian population model. We recover parameters consistent with previous analyses of the EOS and binary neutron star population, finding the latter to fit a bivariate normal distribution with mean $(μ_1,μ_2) = (1.39,1.27) M_{\odot}$ and width $σ= 0.08 M_{\odot}$. Furthermore, we implement novel coordinate transformations in our pipeline, with which we have discovered that the ad hoc prior boundaries used for this EOS family may be too restrictive. We present results with relaxed yet still physical prior boundaries, noting vastly improved hyperparameter posteriors and modestly different equation of state inferences.

entries.title: AGC 322753: a Dark Galaxy Candidate detected by ALFALFA and FASHI
entries.abstract: We report the possible detection of a Dark Galaxy Candidate (DGC; AGC 322753), via the cross-matching of the Arecibo Legacy Fast ALFA (ALFALFA) and the FAST All Sky HI (FASHI) HI blind surveys. It is detected by both surveys at the same recessional velocity, with a comparable HI mass of $2\times10^{9}$ M$_\odot$, and with similar HI spectral features. The ALFALFA and FASHI spectra show a double-peaked profile, compatible with a disc-like ordered rotation, and an HI linewidth at 50 per cent of the peak ($W_{50}$) of $\sim$85 km s$^{-1}$. The common intersection of the two beams allows the source position to be constrained with much greater precision than in either survey individually. Being detected by both radio telescopes, a Radio Frequency Interference (RFI) origin is excluded. No evidence of an optical counterpart was found down to $\sim$27.5 mag arcsec$^{-2}$ in the DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys, which leads to a stellar mass limit of $M_\star \lesssim 5\times10^{7}$ M$_\odot$. Given this stellar mass limit, AGC 322753 has $M_{\rm HI}/M_\star \gtrsim 40$. The HI mass is higher than expected for totally starless haloes; this could imply that AGC 322753 is not completely 'dark' but could host a luminous counterpart below the current optical detection limit.

analysis.result: 在局域 Heisenberg–Euler 本构模型的正双折射分支上，用垂直传播的有限场分裂乘以 sin²θ 会高估非垂直传播的精确分裂；相对误差在趋近磁场方向时最大，但该方向的绝对双折射趋于零。二阶解析展开在 B/B_cr≤100 的范围内，对归一化角度分裂的最大绝对残差为 2.72×10⁻⁴。正文报告：最强示例磁星的近轴误差为 5.17%，20°发射帽平均为 4.91%，代表性径向光线的累积真空相位误差为 2.30%；这些不是最终观测偏振的同等幅度变化。
analysis.problem: 保留完整有限磁场一圈响应后，任意传播角的双折射分裂能否由垂直传播结果乘以 sin²θ 准确表示？若不能，误差的符号、角度分布、场强标度及其在磁星表面平均和径向相位累积中的物理权重是什么？
analysis.method: 将两种局域折射率改写为共同的角度函数，通过正系数级数证明角度因子的单调性与误差符号，推导数值稳定的有理化分裂表达式及一、二阶相对响应展开。以任意精度计算一圈响应，并用独立 Schwinger 固有时积分交叉检查系数；随后在中心偶极、径向光线模型中计算发射帽平均误差和真空相位累积误差。
assumptions: 采用局域、零温、一圈 Heisenberg–Euler 真空响应；适用背景须在电子 Compton 尺度上缓慢变化，光子须处于软光子范围。
解析符号与单调性结论限定于正双折射分支，即 0≤η_s<η_p<1。
磁星应用采用理想中心偶极，将自转减速场强 B_d 作为赤道归一化并取 B_p=2B_d；相位计算采用径向光线，沿途磁场按 r⁻³ 衰减。
limits: 数值误差只是一圈本构模型的预测，不是完整的 O(α²) QED 结果；真正的两圈项与部分保留的代数非线性项处于相同形式阶数。
未计算系统性的动量依赖色散修正和热修正，局域模型不能据此获得完整的高阶精度预算。
表面平均及真空相位误差不是观测偏振角或偏振度的预测；需要联合等离子体响应、模转换、发射图样、光线几何和磁场拓扑，尤其不能将真空误差直接乘到共振模转换概率上。

analysis.method: 采用 MOCSS 技术，几乎同时打开 NIRSpec 的全部微快门，仅关闭天空位置对应已知明亮天体的快门；通过哈勃超深场的 G140M/F100LP 观测验证该方法，并与曝光时间相近的 NIRISS WFSS 比较。

analysis.reason: 本文研究银河系盘恒星的中子俘获元素丰度及高金属丰度下的 r 过程示踪。摘要未将这些丰度结果与 FRB/PRS、超新星中心引擎、激波与周星介质相互作用、相对论喷流、中微子或致密天体高能观测建立实质联系，因此在当前研究方向的摘要筛选中跳过。
analysis.result: 从 GALAH 巡天的 74,717 颗恒星中发现 17 颗经核验的 Eu 增强银河系盘恒星，满足 [Eu/Fe]>0.7，金属丰度范围为 -0.87<[Fe/H]<-0.21。其中 14 颗还满足 [Ba/Eu]<0，被归为 r-II 恒星；一颗恒星在 [Fe/H]=-0.21 时具有 [Eu/H]=1.01±0.09。全部 17 颗恒星也表现出其他中子俘获元素、尤其是 Nd 的增强，而其余化学组成总体与典型盘恒星一致。两颗具有双星迹象且 Ba、Y 强烈增强，可能涉及慢速或中间中子俘获过程。
analysis.problem: 识别并研究银河系盘中较高金属丰度的 Eu 增强恒星，以示踪该环境中的中子俘获过程，并考察适用于银河晕的 Eu 增强选择标准是否适合银河系盘。
analysis.method: 在 GALAH 巡天样本中识别并核验 Eu 增强恒星，使用通常用于银河晕恒星的 Eu 增强标准以便与文献比较；结合 [Ba/Eu] 和其他元素丰度判断中子俘获过程特征，并提出依赖金属丰度的 Eu 增强选择标准。

Abstract: “Here, we report the discovery of $17$ vetted Eu-enhanced stars ($\mathrm{[Eu/Fe]}>0.7$) in the Milky Way disk with metallicities in the range $-0.87<\mathrm{[Fe/H]}<-0.21$ identified from among $74\,717$ stars in the GALAH survey.”
Abstract: “14 of these stars additionally have $\mathrm{[Ba/Eu]}<0$, marking enhancement from the rapid neutron capture ($r$-) process and making these r-II stars.”
Abstract: “Included in their number is a star with a remarkably high $\mathrm{[Eu/H]}=1.01\pm0.09$ at $\mathrm{[Fe/H]}=-0.21$.”

Abstract: “In addition to Eu, all 17 stars show enhancements in other neutron capture elements, especially in Nd, while otherwise appearing chemically consistent with typical disk stars, particularly in their $α$-element abundances.”
Abstract: “Two of the Eu-enhanced stars exhibit indications of binarity with strong enrichment in Ba and Y, marking potential signatures of the slow or intermediate neutron capture processes.”

Abstract: “Although we use criteria for Eu-enhanced stars typically applied to the halo to enable comparison to literature studies of $r$-process enhanced stars, we propose a new, metallicity-dependent selection for Eu enhancement that is better-suited to the regime of the Galactic disk.”

analysis.reason: 这是一项高分辨率 X 射线光谱的观测系统误差与处理方法研究，对研究组利用窄谱线测量速度、线宽及环境性质有方法学价值，但对象是银河中心分子云，未直接检验 FRB/PRS、瞬变中心引擎或致密天体模型。适合了解并在相关光谱分析时参考，而非列为核心必读。
analysis.result: 作者对四次 XRISM/Resolve 银河中心分子云观测进行轨道分相光谱拟合，报告远离与接近目标阶段的速度差分别为 24±19、24±13、45±17 和 19±12 km/s。四个测量值的均值为 28.0 km/s，单侧单样本 t 检验得到 p=0.0084；作者据此报告在预设的 95% 水平上存在与卫星轨道相关的 Fe Kα 红移调制证据，并将其解释为首次探测到 X 射线望远镜绕地运动的多普勒效应。这是正文报告的结果，不是对原始数据、图像或增益报告的独立核验。
analysis.problem: 绕地运行的 X 射线望远镜是否会在现有高分辨率观测中产生可检测的周期性谱线红移与蓝移，以及如何识别并减轻这种效应对速度和线宽测量的影响。
analysis.method: 从一秒分箱光变曲线的规律观测间断估计轨道周期和遮挡时刻，将轨道划分为四个相位并提取分相光谱；对四次 Resolve 观测的 6.0–6.6 keV 波段使用 tbabs * (powerlaw + zfeklor) 拟合，比较远离目标的 phase 1 与接近目标的 phase 3 的红移，以 Δv=cΔz 表示差值；预先设定 α=0.05，使用单侧单样本 t 检验检验总体均值是否大于零。作者还讨论增益、温度及计数率系统误差，并在无标题附录中以未分箱光谱和 Cash 统计量进行事后稳健性检查。
assumptions: 最规律、最常见的光变曲线间断对应地球遮挡；其起始时刻之间的间隔可估计轨道周期，间断中点可作为遮挡相位中心。
假设检验将不同观测的 Δv 视为来自正态总体；零假设的均值为零，备择假设的均值大于零。
窄波段拟合固定 n_H=5×10^22 cm^-2、连续谱斜率 Γ=0，并采用没有额外速度展宽的 Fe Kα 模型；作者报告改变这些拟合选择不改变主要结论。
limits: 样本只有四次观测，单次速度差的不确定度较大；正文指出所有测量值都高于预期的 14.7 km/s，虽仍在其一至两个标准差范围内。检验支持正均值，不等于精确验证轨道调制幅度。
作者不能排除未知的仪器周期性系统误差，因此轨道运动解释并非已排除所有替代机制后的唯一结论。
正文存在相位编号不一致：Application to XRISM Observations 明确说 phase 2 没有光子，却随后称其红移位于其他相位之间；Discussion 又建议使用 phase 2 数据减轻效应。不能按这些文字直接实施该减轻方案。

analysis.result: 在信噪比 ρ>20 时，任务结束后才坠入黑洞的 EMRI 约占四年任务可探测群体的四分之一，占十年扩展任务可探测群体的六分之一。在所考察的大质量黑洞自旋和次级天体质量范围内，这一占比在四年任务中为 25%–33%，在十年任务中为 13%–20%；任务观测窗口内的可探测比例则随这些参数变化近六倍。
analysis.problem: LISA 可探测的 EMRI 中，有多少将在任务结束后才坠入大质量黑洞，以及这些源如何随任务结束后的剩余寿命等参数分布。
analysis.method: 从天体物理动机支持的种群中抽样，针对给定的距坠入时间反向积分完全相对论性的 Kerr FastEMRIWaveforms 轨迹，计算四年标称任务和十年扩展任务窗口内的完整 LISA 响应，并在信噪比阈值 ρ=10、20、30 下计算可探测比例随距坠入时间的变化。
assumptions: 探测计算采用四年标称观测窗口和十年扩展观测窗口。
可探测比例计算采用信噪比阈值 ρ=10、20、30。
limits: 摘要中的参数变化结果限于作者所运行的大质量黑洞自旋和次级天体质量取值。
任务结束约一年以上才坠入黑洞的 EMRI 可能需要不同于任务期间坠入源的搜索算法。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We calculate what fraction of detectable EMRIs will plunge after the mission ends, and for those we calculate how they are distributed as a function of various parameters, such as their post-mission lifetime.”

Abstract: “To do this, we draw from astrophysically motivated populations, backward-integrate fully relativistic Kerr FastEMRIWaveforms trajectories for a given time to plunge, and compute the full LISA response over both the four-year nominal and ten-year extended observing windows.”
Abstract: “We calculate the detectable fraction as an explicit function of time to plunge at signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) thresholds of $ρ=10$, 20, and 30.”
Abstract: “We find that post-mission EMRIs are roughly one in four of the LISA-detectable population at $ρ>20$ over the four-year mission, and roughly one in six over the ten-year extended mission.”

Abstract: “The in-window detectable fraction varies by nearly a factor of six at $ρ>20$ across the massive black hole spins and secondary masses we ran, while the share stays between 25% and 33% for the four-year mission and between 13% and 20% for the ten-year one across all of them.”

Abstract: “The search for EMRIs that plunge more than $\sim 1$ year after the mission ends may require a different algorithm than the one used for EMRIs that plunge during the mission, and the fact that post-mission detections are a substantial fraction of all detections gives some urgency to developing a detection pipeline suitable for them.”

analysis.reason: 虽然主体是拥挤星场的变星与双星普查，但Rapid Burster的红外对应体、红背毫秒脉冲星伴星识别及X射线源交叉匹配，与致密天体高能观测有实质联系。读出级时间序列提取和伪检出抑制方法也具有研究效用。建议重点阅读致密天体对应体及方法章节，而非将全部恒星分类与光变图集列为本组必读。全部22段材料已读完；本判断不表示已经视觉检查图像、图表或附加数据。
analysis.result: 目录包含1,315个独立变源，其中Liller 1视场915个、Terzan 5视场400个；这些不是已确认星团成员数。作者将源#587确定为Rapid Burster的红外对应体，其变化非周期，具有小时尺度通量变化及第4观测段的表观状态变化。通过位置、周期及射电星历折叠后的相位一致性，将Terzan 5的#344确认为PSR J1748−2446A的伴星。另得到48个不同变源的X射线对应体匹配；这些匹配并不普遍确证其物理类别。

analysis.problem: 在Terzan 5和Liller 1的JWST观测中识别独立变源，并降低变异检测中的伪检出。
analysis.method: 对JWST/NIRCam相邻非破坏性读数组作差，构建约21.5秒采样的时间序列；采用逐像素滞后1自相关图及PSF匹配检测变源，再进行孔径测光、异常值剔除、饱和与积分内斜率校正。使用Lomb–Scargle、BLS及滑动盒单事件搜索，结合人工分类、跨访问匹配和去重构建目录。采用双星光变模型描述形态和历表，并通过天体测量及射电星历检验致密天体对应体。
limits: 未确定所检测变源的星团成员身份，因此视场计数不能直接作为星团成员计数。
红背脉冲星伴星的混光稀释不确定且依赖波段，无法凭振幅比较区分辐照、双星内激波辐射和椭球形变贡献。
双星拟合仅依靠宽带测光，没有径向速度，不能据此精确推断物理参数。
尚未完成信号注入与恢复的定量完整性评估。
citation_leads: V Conclusion: “Applying this pipeline to deep JWST observations of the bulge globular cluster-like objects Terzan 5 and Liller 1, we identify 1,315 unique variable sources: 915 in Liller 1 and 400 in Terzan 5.”

III.2 Detection of variable sources: “In a direct comparison on the same data, detection on the autocorrelation image produced roughly one-third as many spurious detections as detection on a variance-over-mean image.”
IV.6 The Rapid Burster: “The variability is aperiodic, with hour-timescale flux changes and an apparent state change in Segment 4, consistent with the source’s known X-ray behavior.”
IV.1 The variable star population: “We have not established cluster membership for our detections, so these are counts of variables in each cluster’s field rather than of confirmed members.”

IV.7 The infrared counterpart of PSR J1748$-$2446A: “Even with a detection in both bands, the uncertain and band-dependent dilution would prevent an amplitude comparison precise enough to separate irradiation, intrabinary-shock emission and ellipsoidal distortion”

III.9 Source classification: “The fits rest on broadband photometry alone, without radial velocities, so they determine geometry far better than they determine physical parameters, and we release the morphologies and fitted ephemerides only.”
III.8 Sliding-box single-event search: “A quantitative completeness assessment requires signal injection and recovery, which we defer to a dedicated transit-search paper.”

A.1 The fitted models of the correction pipeline: “Groups are corrected only while their median ratio stays at or above 3% and the residual scatter about the quadratic fit stays at or below 5% of that ratio.”

analysis.reason: 论文聚焦原行星盘中的尘埃动力学与碰撞演化。摘要未显示其与 FRB/PRS 环境、超新星中心引擎、激波破越、周星介质相互作用或致密天体高能观测等研究方向存在实质联系；GPU 加速方法本身不足以构成本轮候选依据。
analysis.result: 提出 GameDev，将独立演化的三维尘埃动力学与蒙特卡洛碰撞演化耦合，并通过冻结邻域内的碰撞采样实现粒子间大规模并行。模型支持 NVIDIA CUDA 和 AMD ROCm，另提供较小规模的独立欧拉尘埃流体模型，并在 GitHub 公开。摘要未提供定量性能或精度指标。
analysis.problem: 原行星盘中尘埃碰撞导致的生长与碎裂和尘埃动力学强耦合，而现有尘埃演化代码常采用预设尘埃速度，且多局限于一维或二维空间。
analysis.method: 在预设气体盘中用拉格朗日代表粒子描述尘埃，以交错半解析方法积分轨迹；从每个粒子的最近邻估计碰撞率，并在自适应时间间隔内保持冻结的邻域中采样碰撞事件，结合 GPU 加速与蒙特卡洛碰撞演化。
assumptions: 气体盘为预设，尘埃以拉格朗日代表粒子建模。
碰撞事件采样所用邻域在自适应时间间隔内保持冻结。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Grain growth and fragmentation through dust collisions in protoplanetary disks are strongly coupled with dust dynamics.”
Abstract: “existing dust evolution codes often rely on prescribed dust velocities and are mostly restricted to one or two spatial dimensions.”
Abstract: “a dust evolution model accelerated by graphics processing units (GPUs) that couples independently evolved three-dimensional dust dynamics with Monte Carlo collisional evolution of dust.”
Abstract: “In GameDev, we model dust as Lagrangian representative particles in a prescribed gas disk.”
Abstract: “We integrate particle trajectories with the staggered semi-analytic method”

Abstract: “We estimate collision rates from each particle's nearest neighbors rather than on a grid, preventing physically close particles from being excluded from collision sampling because they lie across a grid boundary.”
Abstract: “we sample collision events against neighborhoods that remain frozen over adaptive intervals, enabling massive parallelization across particles.”
Abstract: “GameDev supports both NVIDIA CUDA and AMD ROCm platforms, provides a smaller-scale standalone Eulerian dust fluid model, and is publicly available on GitHub.”
analysis.research_progress: 相对于摘要所述常采用预设尘埃速度、主要限于一维或二维的既有代码，GameDev 耦合独立演化的三维尘埃动力学与碰撞演化；采用最近邻而非网格估计碰撞率，避免网格边界将物理上相近的粒子排除在碰撞采样之外，并通过冻结邻域实现大规模并行。

analysis.reason: 研究核心是利用银河弥散硬X射线约束轻暗物质，而非高能瞬变、FRB/PRS环境、超新星中心引擎或致密天体的高能活动。未分辨吸积白矮星仅作为背景成分，与研究组方向没有实质联系；使用INTEGRAL数据本身不足以构成相关性。
analysis.result: 在1 MeV至5 GeV质量范围内，对暗物质湮灭截面及衰变半衰期给出95%上限约束。几MeV质量处的湮灭截面约束约为10^-28至10^-26 cm^3/s，衰变半衰期约束为τ≳10^25 s；在大部分质量范围内，相比既有X射线限制最多改善两个数量级。结果还被转化为暗光子动能混合参数ε和标量-Higgs混合角sinθ的约束。
analysis.problem: 二十年的INTEGRAL/IBIS银河弥散硬X射线数据能对亚GeV暗物质湮灭、衰变及轻门户暗物质参数空间施加怎样的约束。
analysis.method: 联合拟合IBIS数据的银河经度分布和能谱，利用形态与光谱信息区分潜在暗物质信号和天体物理背景。背景模型包含银河宇宙线电子的逆康普顿辐射及未分辨吸积白矮星的热辐射，并纳入暗物质产生的电子、正电子在银河传播后产生的次级逆康普顿辐射。
assumptions: 采用由银河宇宙线电子逆康普顿辐射与未分辨吸积白矮星热辐射组成的背景模型。
limits: 所述约束覆盖1 MeV至5 GeV质量范围，并针对e⁺e⁻、μ⁺μ⁻和π⁺π⁻末态。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We present new constraints on sub-GeV dark matter (DM) annihilation and decay using twenty years of diffuse hard X-ray observations from the INTEGRAL/IBIS telescope.”

Abstract: “we simultaneously fit Galactic longitudinal profiles and energy spectra, exploiting their complementary signatures to disentangle potential DM signals from the dominant astrophysical backgrounds.”

Abstract: “We use physically motivated background models combining inverse-Compton (IC) emission from Galactic cosmic-ray electrons with thermal emission from unresolved accreting white dwarfs, and consistently include the secondary IC emission generated by DM-induced electron and positron populations propagated through the Galaxy.”

Abstract: “We conservatively derive 95% upper limits on the annihilation cross section $\langleσv\rangle$ and decay half-life $τ$ for the $e^+e^-$, $μ^+μ^-$, and $π^+π^-$ final states across the mass range 1 MeV to 5 GeV.”

Abstract: “Our constraints are in the range $10^{-28}$ cm$^3$/s $\lesssim \langleσv\rangle \lesssim 10^{-26}$ cm$^3$/s for annihilation and $τ\gtrsim 10^{25}$ s for decay at DM masses of a few MeV, improving upon existing X-ray limits by up to two orders of magnitude over much of the mass range.”
Abstract: “Our bounds are translated into constraints on the kinetic mixing parameter $ε$ of a dark photon and the scalar-Higgs mixing angle $\sinθ$”

citation_leads: Abstract: “Although it is recognized as a common feature in galaxy spectra, its potential for studying stellar populations and recent quenching remains little explored.”

Abstract: “Its enhancement at intermediate ages is strong in some stellar population models with substantial thermally pulsing asymptotic giant branch (TP-AGB) contributions but weak or absent in others.”
Abstract: “We use models based on the X-shooter Spectral Library (XSL) and Flexible Stellar Population Synthesis (FSPS) to examine what drives this behavior and what it can reveal about quenching.”
Abstract: “Controlled FSPS experiments show that the $\rm{H^{-}}$ bump depends on both the amount of TP-AGB light and the stellar template used to represent it.”
Abstract: “The adopted XSL and TP-AGB-on FSPS models predict a transient enhancement following rapid quenching, with a different age response from optical spectral features.”
Abstract: “Combining these diagnostics can therefore provide additional information about recent quenching, although the interpretation depends on the population model and star-formation history.”
Abstract: “An illustrative comparison with existing JWST spectra shows that models including TP-AGB contributions can describe the observed $\rm{H^{-}}$ region reasonably well.”
Abstract: “These results motivate further use of the $\rm{H^{-}}$ bump to test TP-AGB prescriptions and investigate quenching with current and forthcoming observations.”

analysis.method: 采用前作的半解析射电星系演化模型，随机抽取宿主环境、喷流功率、活动时长、视角和观测年龄，生成大规模模拟族群；以总流量及表面亮度阈值筛选可观测样本。喷流功率采用七个对数区间的连续分段幂律，通过Nelder–Mead最小化模拟与观测光度分布的平方差；优化阶段使用预计算的条件光度分布、核平滑和数值积分加速。之后比较投影长度、红移分布及光度函数。活动时长和质量加载方案主要通过长度分布的目视比较选择，并非联合统计优化。

citation_leads: Abstract: “Large-scale magnetic reversals in planets, stars, and accretion disks require a non-linear theory coupling the magnetic field to its sustaining flow.”
Abstract: “We derive exact non-linear solutions to incompressible magnetohydrodynamics in background rotational shear, with large-scale velocity and magnetic fields linear in position (affine form).”
Abstract: “They reveal a cyclic feedback between meridional circulation, shear, magnetic tension, induction, and the Coriolis force.”

Abstract: “In the solar near-surface shear layer (NSSL), moderate shear permits stable 11-year reversals with poleward speeds of 8-12 m/s and poloidal and toroidal amplitudes of 4-11 G and 2.2-3.8 kG near 1 Mm depth, in reasonable agreement with regional observations.”

Abstract: “At stronger shear, an 88-year reversal exhibits a 203-207-year modulation, reproducing the Gleissberg and Suess-de Vries activity timescales but requiring weaker poloidal fields. Such reversals, however, remain observationally unestablished.”

Abstract: “At tachocline density, an 11-year reversal and the inferred return flow require toroidal fields of hundreds of kilogauss over a broad shear range, exceeding large-scale-field reconstructions but partly permitted by seismic upper limits.”
Abstract: “This favors a shallow NSSL origin for a local cycle, while leaving open the issue of a global dynamo.”

Abstract: “Here we report the discovery of four faint DSCs in the halo of the nearby starburst galaxy M82 using archival JWST/NIRCam imaging.”

Abstract: “To establish their nature, we measure their sizes and integrated magnitudes using curve-of-growth and radial profile fits, which yield consistent results between these methods.”

analysis.result: 在给定模拟参数下，壳层动量分布宇宙线驱动的流不稳定性通过受激阿尔芬波周围的回旋相位聚束达到饱和。采用理想闭合与 Landau 闭合的 FPIC 模拟均复现 PIC 的饱和振幅及该机制，表明非线性 Landau 阻尼（NLLD）不决定此参数下的饱和水平。所有模拟中的宇宙线离子均在阿尔芬波参考系内完全各向同性化，包括完全没有 NLLD 的理想闭合模拟。理想闭合下，计算域尺度增大十倍不改变饱和振幅。
analysis.problem: 壳层动量分布宇宙线驱动的流不稳定性如何非线性饱和，以及 NLLD 是否决定饱和水平并且是否为宇宙线离子各向同性化所必需。

assumptions: 驱动不稳定性的宇宙线采用壳层动量分布。

citation_leads: Abstract: “Using fully kinetic particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations, we find that the streaming instability driven by CRs with a shell momentum distribution saturates through gyro-phase bunching around driven Alfvén waves.”

Abstract: “Fluid-PIC (FPIC) simulations with both ideal and Landau closures reproduce the PIC saturation amplitude, and the same gyro-phase bunching mechanism, indicating that nonlinear Landau damping (NLLD) does not determine the saturation level at our simulation parameters ($v_{\rm A} = 0.01c$, $n_{\rm CR}/n_i = 0.01$).”

Abstract: “Notably, the CR ions fully isotropize in the Alfvén-wave frame in all simulations, including the FPIC run with an ideal closure in which NLLD is entirely absent, showing that this isotropization does not require NLLD.”

Abstract: “We additionally confirm, using the FPIC ideal closure, that this saturation amplitude is unchanged across a tenfold increase in domain size, indicating that the mechanism is local rather than dependent on domain-scale processes.”

Abstract: “Together, these results indicate that, at least in this regime, NLLD is not the dominant saturation mechanism for the CR streaming instability, in tension with common assumptions built into CR transport models used in galaxy formation and interstellar medium simulations.”
Abstract: “Whether this conclusion extends to the lower CR densities and Alfvén speeds characteristic of the interstellar medium remains an open question that we address in an upcoming work.”

assumptions: 在 S 星团原位形成情景下研究恒星双星与 Sgr A* 的动力学相互作用。

Abstract: “Unlike massive stars in the Galactic field, which exhibit a binary fraction of about $70\%$, those in the S cluster show a significantly lower fraction.”
Abstract: “We show that the binary deficit arises naturally from dynamical interactions between stellar binaries and Sgr A* in an in situ formation scenario.”
Abstract: “Using K-amplitude data, we derived an observational binary fraction of $f_{\mathrm{obs}} = 0.43 \pm 0.09$ for the S-cluster stars.”

Abstract: “Our dynamical modelling predicts that interactions with Sgr A* cause $18\%$ of the binaries to merge, $20\%$ to be disrupted, and $62\%$ to survive, yielding a theoretical binary fraction of $f_{\mathrm{theo}} = 0.38 \pm 0.10$.”
Abstract: “The predicted binary fraction with distance from Sgr A* is also consistent with independent observational constraints.”

Abstract: “These results show that the decline in binarity towards the Galactic centre is driven by stronger tidal forces, and they support an in situ origin of the S cluster in the same event that produced the Fermi bubbles.”

analysis.problem: 高 CO 光度、在静止系 UV–光学波段看似宁静的后星暴星系，其瞬时恒星形成率是多少，是否仍有被尘埃遮蔽的活跃恒星形成？
analysis.method: 对 SQuIGG⃗LE 巡天中 CO 光度最高的三个大质量星系进行 JWST/NIRSpec G395M/170LP 积分视场光谱观测，空间分辨 Paα、Brγ 和 Brβ，以绘制尘埃校正后的恒星形成率分布。
limits: 约 30–40% 的发射可能来自非恒星形成电离，摘要依据中心空间像素的高 [FeII]/Paα 提出这一可能性。

citation_leads: Abstract: “One of the fundamental uncertainties in the study of galaxies at the interface between star formation and quiescence--post-starburst galaxies--is their instantaneous star formation rate.”

Abstract: “Here, we present JWST/NIRSpec G395M/170LP integral field spectroscopy of the three most CO-luminous massive galaxies in the SQuIGG$\vec{L}$E survey, spatially resolving Pa$α$/Br$γ$/Br$β$ to map the dust-corrected star formation rate.”

Abstract: “We find that these galaxies host star formation rates of $27-80$ $M_\odot \ \mathrm{yr^{-1}}$, though $\sim30-40\%$ of the emission may arise from non-star-forming ionization (AGN or shocks), implied by high [FeII]/Pa$α$ in central spaxels.”

Abstract: “We also find effective $A_{\mathrm{Pa}α}\sim1$ and individual $\sim700$ pc spaxels with $A_{\mathrm{Paα}}\sim2$, implying significant dust obscuration of nebular regions that contribute little to the rest-optical lines.”
Abstract: “These galaxies are not consistent with total quiescence; the measured star formation rates place these galaxies on or above the main sequence.”
Abstract: “However, their star formation rates \textit{are} significantly lower ($\sim0.5-1$ dex) than the peak star formation rates inferred from spectrophotometric fitting.”

Abstract: “We propose that the CO luminous post-starburst phase represents the last gasp of star formation in galaxies on the rapid quenching pathway, and that dust-obscured star formation, outflows, and (speculatively) an uncertain CO-to-H2 conversion reconcile their gas exhaustion with observed timescales of fading.”

analysis.problem: 中等红移后星暴星系中冷气体外流的普遍性、性质及其与快速恒星形成淬灭的关系。
analysis.method: 利用含超过 1300 个后星暴星系的 SQuIGG$\vec{L}$E 巡天，将光谱按恒星质量、恒星形成率及比恒星形成率、星暴质量、星暴质量比例和淬灭后时间分箱叠加，以 Fe II 和 Mg II 吸收线搜寻并表征冷气体外流。
citation_leads: Abstract: “In this work, we search for and characterize cool gas outflows traced by Fe II $λλ$2586,2600 and Mg II $λλ$2796,2803 absorption in post-starburst galaxies (PSBs) at $0.5<z<0.9$, which are accessible to ground-based spectroscopy.”

Abstract: “Utilizing the SQuIGG$\vec{L}$E survey containing over 1300 PSBs, we stack spectra in bins of stellar mass, (specific) star formation rate, burst mass, burst mass fraction, and time since quenching.”
Abstract: “We observe blueshifted line centroids indicative of outflows in all stacks except the one containing galaxies that quenched more than 260 Myr ago.”
Abstract: “Outflow velocities decline with increasing time since quenching, while showing little correlation with other galaxy properties.”

Abstract: “The inferred outflows have large mass loading factors of 1 -- 120, maximum velocities above the interstellar medium escape velocities of their host galaxies, and energy and momentum fluxes exceeding those expected from the current star formation.”
Abstract: “Our results suggest that cool gas outflows are ubiquitous in intermediate-redshift PSBs and are likely relic outflows launched by previous starburst or AGN activity.”

Abstract: “These outflows have the potential to quench star formation by transporting gas into the galactic halos, consistent with outflows playing an important role in rapid quenching from intermediate to high redshift.”

analysis.method: 使用软波段 0.3–1.5 keV 与硬波段 1.5–10 keV 的观测计数率构造 HR=H/S，依据保守硬度界限相对于 HR=1 的位置标记软、硬或不确定观测；计算软硬观测比例，并在剔除不确定观测后的时间序列上计算相邻标签跨界比例 CI。对三个描述量进行 z-score 标准化和 Ward/欧氏距离层次聚类，以 silhouette 为主要选簇指标；另外开展留一与 bootstrap 检验、吸收幂律模型响应折叠、随机降采样，以及代表性低计数源的贝叶斯 Poisson 源—背景重分析。

analysis.result: ATClean在所有测试高斯核宽下均未发现显著爆前前兆。对模拟持续时间为2天和300天的事件，80%探测效率对应绝对星等阈值分别为−11.28和−8.98。基于CHIPS模型的亮度—抛质质量转换，不支持具有所比较已知前兆时标、且产生文献所估CSM质量的显著爆发，但不能排除较暗或极短事件。标准同步辐射模型推得外层CSM近似满足ρ∝r⁻²；假定风速50 km/s，失质量率约为8×10⁻⁵太阳质量/年。结合文献估计，作者提出半径≲6×10¹⁴ cm的较致密内层与更外侧延展风状结构，并倾向由延展色球层、脉动驱动超风或多种机制共同解释，而非认为某一种机制已被唯一确定。

analysis.method: 用ATClean清理约8年的ATLAS爆前强制测光，以控制光变评估系统误差和搜索阈值；在o波段光变上进行多宽度滚动高斯卷积，并向控制光变注入模拟高斯爆发，计算恢复率及50%、80%探测效率阈值。使用CHIPS一维辐射流体动力学模型将辐射阈值转换为模型依赖的CSM质量限制。对发现后14–318天的ATCA多频射电观测，使用同步辐射自吸收模型及平滑折断幂律频谱拟合，推导激波半径、磁场和CSM密度，再与文献中的早期光谱、测光及其他波段约束比较。

analysis.result: 正文报告了 14 颗化学特殊星的高分辨率近红外光谱，多数样本出现 Sr II 三重线与 H 波段 Ce III 强线，并在部分恒星中检测到 Gd III、Eu II 和 Nd III。扩大样本后仍未发现系统性强于这些跃迁的未识别谱线。经验等值宽度比较表明，Eu 与 Sr 的绝对丰度近似相当时，Eu II 可与 Sr II 竞争；Nd III 要与 Ce III 强线相当，则需要 Nd 丰度约为 Ce 的 100 倍。因此，正文更支持 Sr II、Ce III 的主要作用，同时提出在重元素高度富集的并合抛射物中，Eu II、Nd III 可能参与 Sr II 附近的谱特征；这不是对千新星中这些元素的新直接确认。
analysis.problem: 重元素近红外原子数据不完整、不够准确，使千新星元素识别存在非唯一性及未知跃迁污染的可能。论文检验此前基于单颗化学特殊星提出的强跃迁重要性是否在不同大气参数和丰度模式下仍成立，并筛选其他可能影响千新星谱线的重元素跃迁。
analysis.method: 使用 Subaru/IRD 获取 9 颗 ApBp 星和 5 颗 AmFm 星的 Y、J、H 波段光谱，光谱分辨率约为 70000。屏蔽严重受地球大气吸收影响的波段，以 Gaussian 或 Voigt 轮廓测量吸收线等值宽度；将线中心与 VALD 及经过实验能级校准的镧系线表匹配，容差为 0.15 Å。用 Turbospectrum/iSpec 合成光谱辅助识别，比较强线排序及等值宽度与丰度的关系，并重新估计 Sr 丰度。
assumptions: 辅助光谱合成采用局域热动平衡和一维平面平行 ATLAS 大气模型。
化学特殊星仅作为富金属大气的代理，不作为本征核合成丰度模式的指示物。
镧系跃迁识别采用较宽松标准：波长匹配且下能级能量低于 5 eV 时，即使模型与观测不一致也可视为已识别。
limits: 原子跃迁概率及文献丰度存在系统不确定性；详细测量 Eu II、Nd III 的 gf 值和丰度超出本文范围。
地球大气吸收和仪器覆盖限制使重要 La III 跃迁无法检验，不能将其未检出解释为对千新星不重要。
化学特殊星光球比千新星更热，代理条件并不完全相同；roAp 星的表观电离程度也可能偏离均匀大气假设。

analysis.reason: 直接对应研究组的FRB/PRS形成渠道、宿主环境及色散、旋转量和散射研究。论文新增矮宿主测量，比较重复与表观非重复FRB的金属丰度分布，并检验整体宿主性质与传播效应的联系，可用于约束低金属丰度磁星形成假说及区分整体ISM与源周环境的作用。其价值在于新增观测、总体统计约束和选择效应分析，不取决于是否构成机制上的突破。
analysis.result: 从78个CHIME/FRB Outriggers定位事件出发，筛选8个矮宿主候选，经恒星质量分析确认5个新矮宿主，log(M*/M☉)约为8.1–9.1。z≤0.2的57个Outrigger宿主给出矮宿主比例下限f_dwarf>0.09；在采用的混合发生率模型下要求χ_SFR>0.4，不支持仅按恒星质量加权的模型。合并文献宿主后，重复与非重复FRB的气相金属丰度分布不同，log-rank检验p=0.001；重复矮宿主偏向12+log(O/H)<约8.35，最贫金属的一组重复宿主多伴随PRS。非重复宿主总体处于普通恒星形成星系的质量—金属丰度分布内。对54个宿主DM、37个宿主RM和24个宿主散射时标的分析，未发现它们与整体金属丰度存在显著相关；剔除PRS关联源后的散射相关经试验校正仍仅为2σ。低金属丰度通过保留恒星角动量促进快速旋转磁星形成，是作者提出的可能解释，而非已证实机制。
analysis.problem: FRB前身形成、重复活动及PRS出现是否依赖宿主金属丰度？矮星系宿主比例是否支持FRB发生率追踪恒星形成而非仅追踪恒星质量？DM、RM和散射能否通过与宿主整体金属丰度的联系，区分整体ISM与源周局域等离子体的贡献？
analysis.method: 以2025年2—10月78个Outriggers定位FRB为母样本，使用PATH进行贝叶斯宿主关联，结合深成像、光谱红移和r波段光度筛选。汇集档案及新增光学、近红外测光与光谱，用Prospector联合拟合测光和光谱以推断恒星质量及恒星族性质；以统一的O3N2强线标定测量气相氧丰度，个别缺少Hβ的宿主改用一致标定的N2诊断。采用含删失数据的log-rank检验比较重复与非重复宿主；用GALFRB模拟不同恒星质量、恒星形成和金属丰度加权的星系总体，并施加星等截断。通过蒙特卡洛估计宿主传播量，结合生存分析、广义Kendall统计及置换检验考察其与金属丰度的相关性。
assumptions: 将恒星质量在1σ不确定度内满足log(M*/M☉)≤9.1的星系定义为矮星系。
limits: 不同瞬变及FRB宿主样本的发现、定位、宿主确认和后随策略不统一，观测分布不能直接视为无偏总体。
FRB 20250410E的SED拟合因数值不稳定未使用星云边缘化；FRB 20250507A的散射上限低于NE2025预测，给定材料未说明该例外的具体处理方式。

analysis.problem: 在核物质与夸克物质之间存在单次一阶相变的情况下，混合星质量—半径关系可能具有哪些拓扑，以及其稳定与不稳定分支如何随控制参数变化。

analysis.result: Star 1 被识别为主序 B5e 星，其快速自转及倾角支持经典 Be 星分类；Star 2 被识别为主序前 B7e 星，吸积特征与变光行为符合正在吸积的 Herbig Be 星。两者的 Chandra 光谱给出 kT ~ 1.7–1.8 keV、logL_X ~ 30.4–30.6 erg/s。作者据此提出，X 射线可能源于受磁场影响的周星活动，与磁约束风激波或磁力矩盘情景相符。
analysis.problem: 确定两颗发射 X 射线的 Be 星的恒星类型、周星物质与变光性质，并探究其 X 射线辐射起源。
analysis.method: 结合 LAMOST 光谱与测光分析、TESS 周期分析、ZTF 光变曲线、Chandra X 射线光谱，以及 Chandra 与 Gaia 坐标的位置比较开展多波段研究。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We present a multi-wavelength study of two X-ray-emitting Be stars, CXOU J052218.4+332820 (Star 1) and CXOU J052304.2+332846 (Star 2), identified from the LAMOST DR5 Hot emission-line stars catalog.”
Abstract: “Our spectroscopic and photometric analyses indicate that Star 1 is a main-sequence B5e star, whereas Star 2 is a pre-main-sequence B7e star.”
Abstract: “TESS period analysis reveals a rapid rotational period of ~ 0.355 d and an inclination angle of ~ 68 deg, confirming the Classical Be nature of Star 1.”

Abstract: “Its ZTF light curves display irregular dimming events of up to ~ 3 mag and quasi-periodic variability on timescales of ~ 50 - 110 d, consistent with circumstellar obscuration in an accreting Herbig Be star.”

Abstract: “Chandra spectroscopy yields moderate plasma temperatures (kT ~ 1.7-1.8 keV) and X-ray luminosities of logL_X ~ 30.4-30.6 erg/s, comparable to those observed in magnetically active coronae.”

Abstract: “Furthermore, the positional agreement between the Chandra and Gaia coordinates indicates that the X-ray emission is spatially associated with the optical systems rather than a nearby resolved companion.”

Abstract: “These results suggest that the observed X-ray emission originates from magnetically influenced circumstellar activity, consistent with magnetically confined wind-shock (MCWS) or magnetically torqued disk scenarios.”

analysis.problem: 瞬变发现数量超过光谱分类能力时，如何利用已有宿主光谱红移，实时提供距离和光度背景信息，可靠关联宿主、优先筛选稀有瞬变并分配后随资源，同时建立可用于种群分析的样本。
analysis.method: DETECT每小时读取TNS报告，以HEALPix索引在30角秒内搜索DESI光谱，并使用Legacy Surveys DR10形态信息构造方向光半径归一化距离进行宿主关联，而非简单最近邻匹配。依星系轮廓采用不同阈值，歧义和红移冲突交人工审核。结合宿主红移、银河消光及仅含带宽项的K校正估算绝对星等，以高光度、核区位置、宿主性质、透镜邻近和快速衰减等标签排序。回溯样本用Haffet拟合合格多波段光变；千新星筛选对照possis模型及AT 2017gfo，并用多年档案和强制测光复核；个别透镜候选另用lenstronomy建模。

DESI偏向明亮、大质量宿主，固定角搜索半径也带来选择限制；作者不对宿主偏移统计中残余的类型差异作物理解读。

analysis.result: 作者构造了两种过程的总率辅助函数近似及可解析反演的四阶 Padé 累积概率近似。同步辐射辅助函数在 χ_e∈(10⁻³,10²) 内相对误差低于 0.7%；Breit–Wheeler 辅助函数在 χ_γ≳1 时相对误差不超过 3.3×10⁻⁴。累积概率导数检验及每种过程 9 万次事件的抽样检验表明，单过程采样谱达到约百分之一精度；较大的相对偏差通常位于谱值很小的区域。这些结果不构成完整级联精度或实际运行加速的验证。
analysis.problem: 如何在强场 QED 蒙特卡洛模拟中，高效抽样同步辐射及非线性 Breit–Wheeler 成对产生的事件发生时间和产物能量分配，避免依赖含特殊函数积分的查找表、插值及累积概率的迭代反演。
analysis.method: 在恒定交叉电磁场背景下推导过程谱，以辅助函数表示总反应率；抽样最终光学深度并累积总率确定事件时刻。通过加权误差最小化拟合辅助函数和四阶 Padé 累积概率，将能量分配反演化为四次方程的解析求根，再由守恒确定另一产物的量子参数。以累积概率导数恢复的谱和随机采样直方图进行独立检验，并为数值异常设置低精度后备反演。

Abstract: “Automatic differentiation also provides exact gradients for the gradient-based samplers in the package.”

analysis.reason: 与研究组的超新星中微子、恒星包层环境及 MeV 高能瞬变观测直接相关。论文把包层产生的 511 keV 回声与地面中微子计数结合，提出检验传播效应的近—远比较方法，并量化光子输运校准要求；即使目前尚不能稳健解释通量亏损，这些方法与限制也具有明确研究效用。
analysis.result: 构造与距离无关的近—远估计量 κ：标准传播预期 κ=1，完全平均的伪狄拉克振荡预期 κ≈1/2。正文给出的振荡特征质量平方劈裂尺度为 δm²≈10⁻¹⁸ eV²×(0.22 kpc/D)×(E★/15 MeV)，不是已实现的观测限制。在 D=0.222 kpc、AMEGO 类有效面积 3000 cm²、20 M☉ 前身星的基准下，预测回声计数为 70.7；若有效面积不确定度为 5%，分辨因子二亏损要求回声归一化 Cγ 的相对不确定度在 2σ、3σ 下分别不超过 48.3%、30.7%。当前光子逃逸处方存在四倍差异，仍可吸收这一亏损。

analysis.problem: 银河系超新星中微子的能量平滑传播抑制，尤其完全平均的活跃—惰性振荡，如何与不确定的源发射归一化区分？能否通过包层产生的伽马射线回声独立锚定恒星表面电子反中微子注量？
analysis.method: 采用富氢包层表面逃逸层近似，计算逆 β 衰变产生正电子并湮灭形成的 511 keV 回声；将回声计数与地面 IBD 计数写成具有相同 IBD 截面加权的表面发射积分，构造 κ=(NIBD/Nγ)×(Aeff Cγ/(Np εIBD))。以共同质量平方劈裂的伪狄拉克模型为例，结合 Garching SFHo 发射模型、SNOwGLoBES 截面及 JUNO 高斯能量响应计算基准谱，并传播计数、背景和不相关系统误差，给出回声统计量与归一化校准精度的要求。
assumptions: 电子反中微子发射球对称，朝向地球一侧包层的注量与恒星表面其他区域相同。
回声采用可无康普顿散射逃逸的表面层近似；该层的自由质子与电子数目分数之比近似均匀，向内光子被吸收，向外的一半光子视为逃逸。
伪狄拉克基准对三对活跃—惰性态采用共同的质量平方劈裂，并在标准振荡相位平均后计算额外传播因子。
基准表面注量采用完全味均分；地面 IBD 效率近似不依赖能量，误差预算采用不相关系统误差。
回声灵敏度基准采用 D=0.222 kpc、AMEGO 类有效面积 3000 cm²、有效面积相对不确定度 5%，并以银河系 511 keV 线背景计算背景计数。
limits: 当前光子逃逸处方存在四倍归一化差异，足以吸收因子二伪狄拉克亏损；稳健解释需要专门的包层光子输运与目标校准计算。
下一代 MeV 望远镜的回声可探测范围仅约为 1 kpc 以内，方法适用的超新星距离有限。
背景估计只包括银河系 511 keV 线，未纳入依赖仪器和能窗的连续谱及仪器背景。
参宿四距离的超新星可能导致 JUNO 高事件率与堆积；采用的效率只是基准，仍需专门的探测器模拟与重建。

citation_leads: Abstract: “We present a study of gas uplift by cavities and its role in promoting the formation of molecular gas in cool-core galaxy clusters.”

Abstract: “Using a sample of 24 clusters, we quantify the parameter space of gas uplift, including lifting masses, velocities, radii, and cooling times, and compare the displaced hot gas to observed molecular gas masses.”
Abstract: “Almost all clusters contain sufficient low-entropy gas within the central $\sim$10 kpc to account for the observed molecular gas.”
Abstract: “The molecular gas mass scales approximately linearly with the maximum gas mass displaced by cavities.”

Abstract: “The mass expected to cool over the lifetimes of the currently observed cavities is comparable to the molecular reservoir in several systems, assuming that 50\% of the displaced gas mass is lifted and cools, whereas other systems contain excess molecular gas.”
Abstract: “This suggests that the molecular gas reservoirs may have accumulated over multiple AGN feedback cycles involving repeated gas uplift and cooling, or through additional processes.”
Abstract: “Overall, our results support a picture in which repeated AGN outbursts with gas uplift promote the condensation of low-entropy gas and help build molecular reservoirs in cool-core BCGs.”
